title: Typography · Recommended text sizes
slide_intent: Show how size and leading work together with column width. Repeating the same passage lets readers judge which setting fits each reading task.
strategic_value: A defined range of text settings can give captions, correspondence and introductory paragraphs a consistent hierarchy across publications.
demonstration: Three settings repeat one passage: 14 pt type on 21 pt leading above, then 9 on 14 for narrow copy and 10.5 on 16 for wider body copy below.
practical_value: Choose the introductory or body setting by function and available measure. The note identifies 10.5 on 16 as the standard for correspondence.

content_islands.name: Format note
content_islands.spec: Use the left column to explain why document format informs size.

content_islands.name: Introductory specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the largest example above the others. Attach a label giving its point size, leading and role.

content_islands.spec: Set the narrow 9 pt and wider 10.5 pt examples side by side. Add the correspondence note beneath the latter.
